title: SARGO: Agreement-Gated Reinforcement and Suppression via On-Policy Self-Guidance for Visual Hallucination Mitigation
abstract: arXiv:2611.19388v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Vision-language models remain susceptible to visual hallucinations, often mixing grounded information with unsupported claims in the same response. Response-level reinforcement learning assigns a shared advantage to all tokens in a response, causing negative updates to suppress correct information alongside unsupported claims. To reduce hallucination while preserving useful visual information, we introduce SARGO (Self-guided Advantage-Routed Grounding Optimization), a post-training framework for selective reinforcement and suppression through on-policy self-guidance. Direct and reciprocal weighting gives better-supported tokens stronger reinforcement on positive updates and weaker penalties on negative updates. Agreement between overall and hallucination-specific advantages selects when to apply this guidance. At the response level, a reference-calibrated reward couples factuality with the retention and expansion of grounded information,

translated_title: SARGO：通过策略内自引导实现一致性门控强化与抑制以缓解视觉幻觉
translated_abstract: 视觉语言模型仍然容易产生视觉幻觉，常常在同一个回复中将有依据的信息与无依据的主张混在一起。响应级别的强化学习为响应中的所有词元分配共享的优势值，导致负向更新在抑制无依据主张的同时也错误地抑制了正确信息。为了在减少幻觉的同时保留有用的视觉信息，我们提出了SARGO（自引导优势路由接地优化），这是一个通过策略内自引导实现选择性强化与抑制的后训练框架。直接与互惠加权使得支撑更充分的词元在正向更新中获得更强的强化，在负向更新中受到更弱的惩罚。整体优势与幻觉特定优势之间的一致性决定了何时应用这种引导。在响应级别，基于参考校准的奖励将事实性与有依据信息的保留和扩展相结合。
tldr: SARGO提出了一种基于策略内自引导的后训练框架，通过一致性门控的选择性强化与抑制机制，让有依据支撑的词元获得更强强化与更弱惩罚，从而在缓解视觉语言模型幻觉的同时保留有依据的视觉信息。
en_tdlr: SARGO is a post-training framework that uses agreement-gated selective reinforcement and suppression via on-policy self-guidance, giving better-grounded tokens stronger reinforcement and weaker penalties to mitigate visual hallucinations in vision-language models while preserving grounded visual information.
